messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: CRITICAL: High host reboot rate detected in us-west2-gpu pool (5 reboots in 12m). Affected service: inference-runtime-prod. Auto-escalating to #incidents. Thread started 1730001234

alice_oncall: Acknowledged. Paging oncall. I'm grabbing the initial impact metrics now — ETA 2m. Who's on infra? @diego_infra?

ben_sre: I'm up. Looking at PagerDuty — multiple alerts for node kernel OOM and ECC pci errors. Correlating with our autoscaler/eviction logs.

cara_runtime: Observing increased 502/504 errors from model-server replicas pinned to affected hosts. Traffic fallback kicked in for some customers. Adding tracing links: https://console/recent/trace?query=host:us-west2-gpu

diego_infra: I'm in. Pulling host IDs. Quick grep of recent events:
```
2026-01-18T15:02:11Z host-gpu-12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=3421, ctxt=0x00000000
2026-01-18T15:03:05Z host-gpu-23 kernel: EDAC MC0: CE memory error, CPU0:csrow0
2026-01-18T15:06:39Z host-gpu-12 systemd: Rebooted by kernel panic
```

diego_infra: Host list with symptoms: host-gpu-12 (reboot), host-gpu-23 (ECC CE), host-gpu-37 (PCIe link reset), host-gpu-45 (OOM kill for nvidia-smi process).

logs-bot: Collected logs from host-gpu-12, host-gpu-23, host-gpu-37. Uploaded to https://internal-logs/1730001234/ and attached recent dmesg snippets.

alice_oncall: Initial customer-impact check: 3 prod tenants showed increased tail latency and ~1% error spike in last 10m. IDs: tenant-A123, tenant-B456, tenant-C789. Edda, can you check CS channels for escalations?

edda_custsuccess: On it. Haven't seen public tickets yet, but I messaged the top two contacts at A123 and B456. They reported transient 5xx starting ~15:02 UTC. Will update.

ben_sre: Hypothesis 1: Provider hypervisor/GPU host instability causing kernel panics and reboots. Evidence: repeated NVRM Xid 79 + PCIe link resets. Hypothesis 2: Noisy neighbor causing ECC CE accumulation leading to OOMs. Need to confirm host-level thermal/firmware events.

cara_runtime: Adding runtime perspective: when a host reboots, our sidecar does a pod eviction; autoscaler tries to reschedule but some model-weights are large -> cold-starts causing 502s. Mitigation we can do now: increase replica backoff tolerance and widen allowed fallback to cheaper CPU-only nodes for low-priority requests.

alice_oncall: Immediate mitigation plan (live):
- diego_infra: Cordon and drain remaining hosts in the affected pool (host-gpu-*) -> avoid new schedules.
- ben_sre: Add provider-support ticket, request host-level telemetry and firmware logs.
- cara_runtime: Temporarily route traffic for low-priority routes to fallback cluster; mark canary flags to reduce load.
- edda_custsuccess: Notify impacted customers with ETA 30m and workaround.

diego_infra: Starting drain on us-west2-gpu pool. Command:
```
kubectl cordon host-node-host-gpu-37 && kubectl drain host-node-host-gpu-37 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Drain started for host-gpu-37 (15:10 UTC).

ben_sre: Raised provider ticket: INC-98765 to cloud vendor with logs and host IDs. Provider support-bot will update here.

provider-support-bot: Vendor ACKed. Opening ticket #VEND-321. Requesting ECC counters, GPU firmware version, PCIe lane status. ETA 45m for first triage.

logs-bot: Pasted aggregated ECC counters for host-gpu-23: 
```
ECC_CORRECTED=1245
ECC_UNCORRECTED=3
```

ben_sre: ECC_UNCORRECTED=3 is concerning. Please capture nvlink and pcie resets: `sudo dmesg | grep -i pcie` and `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,PCI`.

cara_runtime: I'm flipping low-priority routes to cpu-fallback now:
```
PATCH /api/routes/override -> {"route":"/embedding/*","fallback":"cpu-pool","reason":"mitigation: gpu node instability"}
```
Patch deployed at 15:14 UTC. Expect reduced error rate for non-latency-sensitive calls.

alice_oncall: Timeline so far for the RCA doc: 15:02 first NVRM Xid on host-gpu-12, 15:03 CE on host-gpu-23, 15:06 kernel panic/reboot host-gpu-12, 15:10 cordon/drain start. Keeping this thread as the source of truth.

diego_infra: I pulled host BIOS/firmware versions: host-gpu-12 v2.1.3, host-gpu-23 v2.1.3, host-gpu-37 v2.0.9. Notable: host-gpu-37 still on older firmware.

ben_sre: Hypothesis update: Mixed firmware in pool -> some hosts hit a firmware bug under pcie stress leading to GPU Xid 79. Noisy neighbor may exacerbate but primary root appears firmware/PCIe error.

cara_runtime: Are we seeing sustained memory ECC corrects prior to crash? That would indicate hardware degrading. logs-bot, paste memory error rate over last 24h for these hosts.

logs-bot: Memory ECC corrected counts (24h window):
```
host-gpu-12: corrected=987, uncorrected=0
host-gpu-23: corrected=1245, uncorrected=3
host-gpu-37: corrected=102, uncorrected=0
```

ben_sre: Pattern: host-gpu-23 has uncorrected errors -> candidate for immediate isolation. host-gpu-12 had lots of corrected errors then kernel panic -> possible failing DIMM or GPU memory controller starting to degrade.

alice_oncall: Action items (assigning):
- diego_infra: Isolate host-gpu-23 and schedule out-of-band replacement/firmware update. (owner: diego_infra)
- ben_sre: Draft initial incident impact note for postmortem; collect traces + error counts. (owner: ben_sre)
- cara_runtime: Ensure fallback rules remain in place and monitor error rate. (owner: cara_runtime)
- edda_custsuccess: Send interim customer update. (owner: edda_custsuccess)
- provider-support-bot: Keep vendor ticket open and push for hardware telemetry. (owner: provider-support-bot)

diego_infra: Isolation command run: `cloudctl host isolate --id host-gpu-23 --reason "uncorrected ECC"` -> succeeded. Scheduling replacement at next maintenance window, but requesting expedited swap under vendor ticket.

edda_custsuccess: Sent updates to A123/B456/C789: "We've detected GPU host instability in us-west2; mitigation in progress, some requests may be routed to CPU fallback. No data loss expected. ETA for full remediation 2-4 hours."

ben_sre: Current system impact: error spike reduced from 1% to 0.2% after drains and fallback. Tail latency for affected endpoints improved by ~200ms. Marking mitigation effective.

cara_runtime: Observability note: we should add a short-term alert to detect rising ECC_UNCORRECTED per-host (threshold 1) so we can preempt similar incidents. Filing a follow-up ticket.

alice_oncall: Provider update: vendor reports seeing "PCIe link training errors" on host-gpu-12 and recommends running a PCIe rescan and upgrading GPU firmware to v2.1.5 across pool. They suspect intermittent lane flapping on the NIC/GPU riser card.

ben_sre: That aligns with Xid 79 (NVRM PCIe errors). If vendor confirms riser card, that's hardware replacement. Need plan for larger migration: sequential cordon+drain+replace hosts, keep fallback allowing SLA targets.

diego_infra: Proposed remediation plan for next 48h:
1) Patch firmware to v2.1.5 on a small canary subset of hosts.
2) Monitor ECC counts and PCIe errors for 2h.
3) If stable, roll firmware across pool with staggered drain/reboot and replacement for hosts with persistent uncorrected ECC.
4) Replace riser cards as needed for hosts with persistent PCIe link issues.

alice_oncall: Good. Ben, please add these steps to the postmortem skeleton and tag owners + timelines. I'll keep this thread open for live RCA notes.

provider-support-bot: Vendor note added to VEND-321: "Running firmware sanity check and requesting physical host inspection for riser/slot connectors. ETA field tech 6-12 hours depending on region."

ben_sre: For the RCA doc: suspected root cause (working): PCIe lane instability + mixed firmware -> GPU driver Xid 79 -> kernel panic -> host reboot -> cascade of pod evictions -> increased error rates for affected tenants. Contributing factors: lack of ECC_UNCORRECTED alerting, mixed firmware, and cold-start sensitivity of large models.

cara_runtime: Live mitigation log: fallback rules applied at 15:14 UTC, host drains started at 15:10 UTC, host-gpu-23 isolated at 15:20 UTC. Error spike largely mitigated by 15:25 UTC.

edda_custsuccess: Customers A123/B456 confirmed they saw transient errors and accepted us using CPU fallback. No escalation to legal.

alice_oncall: Closing live operations loop: mitigation holding, vendor engaged. We'll reconvene for postmortem draft in 48h. If anything changes ping here. Thanks all for quick responses. :heart:

ben_sre: I'll follow up with draft RCA and attach logs/commands used. Leaving notes for postmortem: add runbook step to detect firmware skew and to proactively rotate hosts showing >10 corrected ECC in 24h.

diego_infra: I'll schedule the firmware canary and prepare replacement hardware kit for us-west2.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived for short-term mitigation. Reactivate with `incident-bot reopen 1730001234` if new symptoms appear.
